# Form Items: Delete a Form Item

Area overview and notes: [form-items.md](../form-items.md)

`DELETE /users/{userId}/form-items/{formItemId}` · tenant-scoped token

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `userId` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account (User) who owns the form item. |
| `formItemId` | Your system's unique identifier for a form item. |

**Response 204**: Delete request successfully completed.

**Errors:** 404 Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
